response.explanation: At line 5, src/presentation/server.ts imports DropTextClient from the persistence layer. At lines 24-27 it builds the client with DROPTEXT_BASE_URL and DROPTEXT_API_KEY taken from the environment, then passes it into the RinkService constructor at lines 12-28. The file acts as the composition root: it starts the process, wires the concrete persistence adapters (SessionRepository, BookingRepository, HireStockRepository, PuckPayClient, DropTextClient) into the business service, and starts the HTTP app. FF-S03 flags the import because a presentation-layer file depends directly on a persistence-layer module and skips the business layer between them. This presentation file now knows about a concrete outbound SMS/text adapter and its configuration, and it should not. The code itself is only dependency injection; no handler calls DropTextClient directly. The same pattern appears at lines 1-4 for the other persistence imports, so this edge is one of several wiring dependencies, not a stray data-access call. None of the material I was given (docs, ADRs or code comments) says whether server.ts is meant to be an approved composition root.
